name: agent-drawing-board
description: Draw on and read a Collab drawing board (Excalidraw-style, shared with the operator, who edits it in the dashboard) via `tclaude agent drawing-board`: create, ls, show (with --since / --view), snapshot, add, text, connect, move, layout, patch, rm, open/close your drawing board session, from-process (sketch a process template as a flowchart), from-fleet and fleet-changes (a staffing map of the fleet). Use when the operator asks to "sketch it", "draw it on a drawing board", "put it on the whiteboard", says "this"/"here" about one, when a `[drawing-board <id>]` mail arrives in your inbox, or when agreeing a design, plan or process with the operator visually. A drawing board of your group is yours to read and draw on as a member; any other drawing board needs `drawing-boards.read` / `drawing-boards.write` (not default-granted). Not for showing a web page you serve (that is agent-page), not for editing a process template (process-templates), and not for federation content boards (`docs/federation-boards.md`).

findings.excerpt: tclaude agent drawing-board create plan --title "Release plan" [--group <group>]
tclaude agent drawing-board from-process flow review   # template "review" as a flowchart (p-<step> ids); redraw replaces it
tclaude agent drawing-board create cache-design --title "Cache design"
